description: Deploy script (slice D1). See briefing in delegation prompt.
steps: scripts/build-site.mjs: copy only index.html, css/, js/ (plus icons/manifest if present) into git-ignored site/ (add site/ to .gitignore); fail if any relative import in js/ or index.html script/link refs does not resolve inside site/; allowlist only; npm run build:site
scripts/deploy-site.sh <user@host:path>: builds, prints plan, default rsync dry run with --delete, real run only with explicit --yes flag; no hardcoded hosts

docs in SETUP.md or design/deploy.md: how to run, deletes the 7 extra files (.gitignore, dev-server.mjs, eslint.config.js, package.json, package-lock.json, playwright.config.js, server/suggest.js), optional Apache dotfile rule, needs rsync+ssh from Mac
tests/logic/build-site.test.js: build to temp dir, assert exact file set and exclusions, imports resolve
update PROGRESS.md and mark D1 built in design/web-parity-plan.md; one commit
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint and npm run test:logic pass
build output contains only index.html, css/**, js/**
verification: npm run build:site && find site -type f
